I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in our direct message. Nothing has been sent; it's waiting as a draft.

The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. - proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate as Marcus Lindqvist gave it and says Anselm approved sharing it.

As CFO, Anselm can approve sharing finance figures, and he gave that approval in this message. Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve the mail.
